title: The demo seeder no longer deletes genuine reports
notes: `wipeDemoData` matched `report_id LIKE 'demo-%'`, and a report id is
written by the reporting organisation, so `--force` deleted any real
aggregate report whose id began `demo-`, its normalized events, and its
result: migration `0033` adds `raw_reports.is_demo`, set at insert time by the seeder and backfilled for rows it wrote before the column existed (prefix plus the two other values only the seeder writes, so the backfill does not repeat the bug it fixes). `wipeDemoData` and `isDemoAlreadySeeded` both select on that column.
evidence: `pnpm run check:ci` green — 106 test files, 618 tests, `check-migrations: OK`. `test/wipeDemoData.test.ts` keeps a genuine `demo-`-prefixed report across a wipe and reports nothing seeded when only such a report exists.
